messages.subject: Power & Energy Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Helen,

Your global power and energy leadership-search experience across utilities, renewables and infrastructure is highly relevant to my background. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where energy growth depends on credible institutional engagement, regulatory discipline and responsible development. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
